title: feat(spec)!: a type:'url' action's target declares its closed scheme set — http(s)://, mailto: and in-app paths — at both url-action doors
body:
Fixes #23010

Clause-②: no (narrowing: the published accept set of a `type: 'url'` target narrows; the lane charter reads a narrowing as `no`, where the card's own text says `yes`, and `yes` would not be wrong either)

The spec half of ruling A+ on objectstack-ai/objectui#12191 (maintainer's word, carried verbatim in the card: 「22861  objectui#12191 同意。」). The runner half landed as objectstack-ai/objectui#12230 (`334f0cff98`).

## What changed

On both url-action doors, a `type: 'url'` action's `target` now has a closed scheme set, the same set the console's action runner opens at the click:

- an `http://` or `https://` URL (the scheme compared case-insensitively);
- a `mailto:` address;
- an in-app path that starts with `/` or `./`;
- a template that opens with `${`. The runner judges it after interpolation, at the click; the door leaves it alone.

Every other target is refused at `target`, with a message that names the reason and the admitted set: `javascript:`, `data:`, `tel:` and every other scheme; `http:` or `https:` without the `//`; a protocol-relative `//host`; `/` followed by a backslash; a tab, line feed or carriage return anywhere; and a bare relative target such as `thanks`, `../thanks`, `?tab=2` or `#top`. `target` on `script` / `flow` / `modal` / `api` / `form` is untouched, and so are interpolation and `openIn`.

- `packages/spec/src/ui/navigation-target.ts` (new): the one grammar, `navigationTargetRefusal(raw, subject)`. It is reached by relative import only, like `action-target-aliases.ts`, because `action.zod.ts` rides the `ui` barrel and an export there would grow the published API. #23004 (the empty-state link, `Blocked-by` this card) can import it from `ui/view.zod.ts` with no copy. The admitted schemes are one table; the refusal text is built from it, so admitting a scheme is one row.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`: one `superRefine` per door (`ActionSchema`, and `InlineActionSchema` after the legacy `type: 'navigation'` / `to` fold), scoped to `type: 'url'`. An empty target is left to the target-required rule, so it reports once. The `target` describe and TSDoc state the set.
- D3 entry `ui-action-url-target-scheme-set-closed` and `.changeset/23010-url-action-target-scheme-set.md` (`minor`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, ADR-0087 `registered`, FROM → TO table).
- Fixture triage: one fixture changed. `src/ui/action.test.ts`'s all-types loop gave its url arm the bare `test_handler`. That was never a navigation target; the fixture now writes `/test_handler`, and the other arms keep their names.
- `content/docs/references/**`: regenerated for the describe (4 files, `check:generated` named only `check:docs`).
- **File surface, beyond the claim's literal list (declared):** `navigation-target.ts` is a new sibling module because the dispatch delegated the predicate's placement and asked for it non-public, and `action.zod.ts` is barrel-exported whole (`ui/index.ts`: `export * from './action.zod'`). The D3 entry file is what `check:adr-0087-registration` requires: a changeset that carries a FROM → TO prescription cannot claim `no-migration-prescription`.

## The lane decision, measured against the runner

The door admits, for a literal target, exactly what objectui's `classifyNavigationTarget` admits (`packages/core/src/actions/navigationTarget.ts`, read at objectui `origin/main` `7578323`): tab / LF / CR anywhere refused; `^https?://` (case-insensitive) admitted; `^mailto:` (case-insensitive) admitted; `./` admitted; `/` admitted unless its second character is `/` or a backslash; everything else refused. **No difference was found between the classifier and the lane paragraph.** The test file's section 3 replays the runner's own pinned cases from `navigationTarget.mailto-12191.test.ts` at that sha and answers each the same way at the door.

## Fork clause: no producer writes a refused target

The instrument looked at every literal within 8 lines of a `type` / `actionType` of `'url'` or `'navigation'`, in TS, JS, JSON, MD and MDX, plus YAML `type: url`. Positive control: the showcase's `OpenDocsAction` (`https://objectstack.ai`) is found.

- objectstack at `df7a137923`: 9 url-action target sites outside tests, all admitted. The hits it refuses are not url-action targets. They are `target: '_blank'` link attributes on app navigation items (`content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` ×3) and a neighbouring `type: 'form'` target (`content/docs/ui/forms.mdx:415`).
- objectui at the pin `9646e2ed2bf3` and at `origin/main` `7578323`: 8 sites each, all admitted. The refused hits are `_blank` nav attributes (`apps/console/src/preview-samples.ts`, `content/docs/guide/designing-app-navigation.md`, `packages/types/src/app.ts`).
- A grep for a non-admitted scheme literal in any `target` / `to` / `actionUrl` / `navigate` / `newTabUrl` value finds tests only: objectui `ActionRunner.test.ts`, `ActionRunner.onSuccessNavigation.test.ts` and `element-button-mailto-12191.test.tsx` (main only). These tests exercise the runner's refusal.

## Every schema path where a url-action target is authored

Reach was measured through `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema.safeParse`, the parse `os validate` runs, and `defineStack`, with `javascript:alert(1)` as the target. Where the props bag is judged by `@objectstack/lint`'s `validateComponentProps`, that gate was measured too.

| path | status | measured |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ActionSchema.target`, `type: 'url'` (registered actions; also reached by `record:alert`, page toolbars and `action:bar`, which name declared actions) | **changed** | refused at `actions.0.target` by `defineStack` and the stack parse |
| `InlineActionSchema.target` / `to`, `type: 'url'` or `'navigation'` (`element:button`'s `action`) | **changed** | `ElementButtonPropsSchema` refuses at `action.target`. A page's `properties` bag is outside the stack parse, so `os validate` reports it through the props gate as a `component-props-invalid` **warning**. That gate is advisory by its own header, and its posture is not this card's. |
| `action:button` / `action:icon` rows, `actionType: 'url'` + `target` (`component.zod.ts`) | out of scope: outside this card's two named doors and outside the claim's file surface | accepted, 0 findings |
| `action:group` / `action:menu` members, `type: 'url'` + `target` (`component.zod.ts`) | out of scope (same reason) | accepted, 0 findings |
| `DashboardHeaderActionSchema.actionUrl` with `actionType: 'url'` or omitted, which objectui's `DashboardRenderer` defaults to `'url'` (`dashboard.zod.ts`) | out of scope (same reason) | accepted |
| `ActionSchema.onSuccess.navigate` (`api` / `script` actions; the runner classifies it too) | out of scope: a different key, with a `${result.*}` scope; no ruling covers it | accepted |
| `ActionSchema.newTabUrl` | out of scope: the runner does not classify it (only `ActionDef` declares it) | not measured |
| App navigation `{ type: 'url', url }`, `FormView.submitBehavior.url` | not url actions. The first is app-shell nav; the second has its own stricter relative-only rule. | n/a |

The four out-of-scope rows are one family: the doors would reuse `navigationTargetRefusal` with no second grammar. They are reported to the seat, not filed here.

## Tests and gates

All spec and gate readings are at `64b6470c9`, the branch head after merging `origin/main` `c5b43b606`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: exit 0. `check:generated` first named one stale artifact, `check:docs`. `gen:docs` rewrote the 4 reference pages. At `64b6470c9`, `check:generated` exits 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/spec` suite (`vitest run --project local`): 655 files, 19790 passed, 1 todo, exit 0. The new `action-url-target-scheme-set.test.ts` holds 148 tests.
- **Ablation** (one-time proof, not kept). `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the registered door's `.superRefine(refuseUnopenableUrlTarget(…))`: anchor 1 → 0, blob `2ef003fa9e4f` → `e0687bd797b0`. The new file then read **48 failed / 100 passed**: the 19 registered-door refusals, the 19 admitted-set checks and the 10 runner-parity refusals. The inline-door and acceptance cases stayed green, as expected. After the restore the blob equals HEAD (`2ef003fa9e4f`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Consumers ran at `f22d8b80f`, the pre-merge head. The merge's added lines carry no url-action producer; the only hit is one changeset prose line.
  - `@objectstack/lint`, full suite: 137 files, 6569 passed.
  - `@objectstack/platform-objects`, full suite: 70 files, 1096 passed.
  - `@objectstack/example-showcase`, full suite: 33 files, 409 passed.
  - `@objectstack/runtime`, **narrowed**: 7 files, 142 passed.
  - `@objectstack/cli --project unit`, **narrowed**: 4 files, 76 passed. Two of the files the narrowing named, `generate-string-family-width.pin.test.ts` and `verify-author-time-stage.test.ts`, are in the `integration` tier. That tier is declared to CI.
  - The narrowing, declared. The population is every test file that writes a `type` / `actionType` of `'url'` or `'navigation'`, or that imports `ActionSchema`, `InlineActionSchema` or `defineAction`: 7 of 360 runtime test files and 8 of 479 cli test files. Every other test reads only in-tree producers, and those are all measured admitted (above), so their verdict cannot move. Blind spot: a test that builds a url action with a computed `type`. CI runs both full suites.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derived 111 commands at `64b6470c9`. **All 111 exit 0.** `--ran` reconciles 111 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The first pass, at `f22d8b80f`, had 3 exit-3 prerequisite refusals, all green at `64b6470c9`:
  - the teardown self-test's pinned control commit was missing from the shallow clone (fetched, then green);
  - `check:skill-examples` needed `@objectstack/client-react` built;
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed 8 unbuilt packages.
- `check-adr-0087-registration`: `registered ui-action-url-target-scheme-set-closed (new here)`. `check:nul-bytes` and the raw control-byte self-scan of the touched files are both clean.
- Not run locally, declared to CI: the full `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/runtime` suites, and the cli `integration` tier.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` § URL Actions teaches two admitted targets (`/_console/dashboards/…`, `https://www.google.com/maps/…`) and does not state the set. The reference page now carries it through the describe. A one-sentence statement there is a docs nicety outside the claim's surface.
- The props gate's warning posture means an `element:button` with a refused inline target still publishes with a warning, until that gate's own error upgrade.
